name: The Severed Head
label: Quest
description: Vigorous digging turns up the head of a male orc, ragged where it was cut from the neck. Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.
intro: Vigorous digging turns up the head of a male orc, ragged where it was cut from the neck. Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck. His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have another matter to report, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is the head of Marg Nighteye! As I feared, he is dead.
Look at the wound on his neck! Could a weapon have made that ragged cut, or did some beast slay our agent?
This is a mystery we must solve, friend. We must discover if Marg's death was at the hands of the Alliance!
